elements.name: objective
elements.text: A place on the hill. City visit complete.
Fabricate the Stabilised Pistol Grip at Brann's workbench in Salvage, on the north avenue.

elements.name: log
elements.text:
Linn: Meet me on the hill.
Ward: Welcome back to Ward. Progress restored · field order: Steady Hands. Some saved entries no longer exist and were skipped: loot generator state.
Brann: Ossa radioed ahead: said you cleared the depot nest. Let's see the haul... a worker servo, still twitching. Good. A scrap pistol kicks like a mule; a grip built round that servo takes the kick out of it. The bench is at the back.
You: Show me the bench.
Brann: Pick the Stabilised Pistol Grip from the schematics and fabricate it: one servo, two measures of scrap alloy, five of tier-one nanites. Then fit it to the pistol at the same bench. Short of alloy or nanites? I sell both, and servos too if you've the credits.
You: Use the bench.
